title: Football Heads 2026
desc: Step onto the field and dominate crazy 1v1 football matches! Outplay your opponents using powerful kicks and unique power-ups. Finally let them know who is the boss with the emotes system - become a football legend today!.
howto: Use the arrow buttons to move and jump across the field
Perform various kicks with the ball buttons
Score more goals in the given time and win the match
Climb divisions and unlock all rewards
Random match powerups and player emotes are available
tips: Timing beats power — wait for the perfect moment.
Learn one mode well before jumping into tournaments.
